provenance: PAR-230 isolated Windows CLI startup captures. No user authentication, existing session, production canvas or shared daemon was used.
isolation: Allowlisted OS execution environment; HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA/TEMP/TMP/XDG_* and CLI home overrides point to disposable directories. Working directory is a new empty workspace.
format: text: active xterm visible buffer; styled: SerializeAddon.serialize({scrollback:0}), an ANSI replay, not line-oriented tmux capture. Replay through TerminalEmulator before using a line-oriented SGR reader.
limitations: Startup dialogs only. The agy preview contains illustrative code and activity labels; these are onboarding artwork, not executed work. An indicated model in that screen is not proof of a running authenticated turn.
